name: Desert Table Events
tagline: Private dinners and after-party rooms off the Strip, for conference weeks in Las Vegas.
bio: I'm Nico. I run a private dining room and a lounge ten minutes off the Strip, booked mostly during big conference weeks. Your guests get a quiet room and a real conversation instead of a casino ballroom.
terms: Free to cancel up to 30 days before conference weeks; 50% inside 30 days.
backupPlan: Two chefs and an events manager on every booking.

experiences.name: Conference-week private dinner
experiences.desc: Twenty seats, four courses, a car service option from the conference hotels.
experiences.allIn: Room, food, wine or zero-proof pairing, service and tax. Cars from the Strip $25 a person.

experiences.name: After-party lounge
experiences.desc: The lounge for up to 250 with a DJ, bar and photo wall.
experiences.allIn: Venue, DJ, open bar for 3 hours, staff and tax.
